Lets ArcX read the text on your screen so a workflow can act on whatever you are looking at — summarise an article, explain an error, reply to a message — without you selecting or copying anything first.

ArcX only reads the screen at the moment you run a workflow that needs it. It never records in the background, and password fields are skipped. The text it reads is sent to the AI provider you configured in ArcX, so only enable this if you are comfortable with that provider seeing what is on screen.

You can turn this off here at any time. Every other part of ArcX keeps working without it.
Silent notification shown while the ArcX bubble is on screen. Android requires it.
Tap the bubble to run a workflow from any app.
Star a workflow in ArcX to reach it from here.
Run a favorite ArcX workflow straight from the home screen.
